text:
sasha (Finance): Noticed an odd spike — about 32 invoices in NetSuite from last night have missing VAT codes and 4 customers show duplicate one-off credits. All tied to the same webhook window. Anyone seen this pattern?

nina (Billing Ops): I saw the NetSuite import logs. The invoice import step ran twice for the same batch id 2026-09-14-03. First run mapped taxes, second run created invoices but left tax field blank for some rows.

liam (Eng): Pulled webhook receipts from our forwarder. Stripe delivered the event once but our proxy retried with a different Idempotency-Key on the second attempt. The importer uses the Idempotency-Key for dedupe (bad assumption). Example:```
event=evt_2LmnZ999
proxy-delivery=1 status=200 idempotency=ik_7f4c
proxy-delivery=2 status=200 idempotency=ik_7f4c
proxy-delivery=3 status=200 idempotency=ik_7f4c-1
```
So the mutated key bypassed the dedupe and re-triggered hooks (promo-credit).

stripe-bot: webhook evt_2LmnZ999 delivered to /webhooks/stripe; 3 sends recorded. See: https://dashboard.stripe.com/events/evt_2LmnZ999

recon-bot: nightly-check found ledger mismatch for 4 customers. report: /recon/ledger/2045678800.csv

sasha (Finance): Do not push any of these invoice batches to NetSuite exports. I'll need a CSV of affected customer ids and invoice numbers to prepare manual credit reversals.

nina (Billing Ops): Pulling IDs now — NSINV-9091 .. NSINV-9122 (32 invoices). Duplicates flagged: NSINV-9099, NSINV-9106, NSINV-9118, NSINV-9120. Attaching list to BILL-2049.

liam (Eng): Quick remediation: 1) pause netSuite-export job for window 03:00-04:00. 2) revert importer to dedupe on stripe.event.id and invoice.id only. 3) Add guard to drop events if same stripe_event_id seen with multiple Idempotency-Key values within 15m. I'll open a short rollback PR and a test that simulates header mutation.

rebecca (RevOps): We were running a targeted pricing test that grants a promo_credit when invoice metadata.flag=testpromo. That hook likely ran twice. Please capture the original promo metadata so we can avoid re-crediting afterwards.

liam (Eng): Created ticket INF-5091 and PR: https://git.internal/redwood/billing/pulls/441. Paused the NetSuite sender. Also asked infra to check proxy health for any header rewrite bugs. @ops can you confirm proxy didn't strip/alter headers on retries?

nina (Billing Ops): I'll prepare manual adjustments and credit memos for the 4 customers and queue for approvals. Also tagging support to craft outbound messages if customers ask.

recon-bot: duplicate-credits alert created for 4 customers (alert_id dup-2045678901).

sasha (Finance): Thanks. After adjustments, I want a one-off audit: compare Stripe gross, tax, credits vs NetSuite staged rows before any final push. If counts mismatch we stop the export.

liam (Eng): Understood. Follow-ups: ask Stripe if they ever mutate or add Idempotency-Key on resend; change importer to prefer stripe.event.id as canonical dedupe key; add metric for "same event id, >1 idempotency key" to page on >5 in 10m.

nina (Billing Ops): Filed BILL-2049 with the invoice list and added customer emails. Scheduling a 20-min sync at 10:30 to sign off on reversals.

sasha (Finance): Good. Keep me posted and please do not export any of the NSINV-9091..NSINV-9122 rows until signoff.
